Same 12 pre-existing failures as baseline (identical set, unrelated to this fix — they're API mismatches like `_ClassBuilder.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'slots'`), and 1330 passed vs 1329 before (my new regression test now passes).

## Summary

Fixed `_transform_attrs` in `src/attr/_make.py`: PR #1401 added an order-check loop right after `field_transformer` runs, which consumed `attrs` if it was a generator (a valid pattern for `field_transformer`, working since 25.1.0). Once consumed, the subsequent alias-resolution loop and `AttrsClass` construction saw an empty sequence, silently dropping all fields.

Added `attrs = tuple(attrs)` right after the `field_transformer` call to materialize it before any loop consumes it, plus a regression test (`test_field_transformer_returns_generator` in `tests/test_hooks.py`) verifying a generator-based `field_transformer` still produces the expected fields and `asdict()` output.

Full test suite: 1330 passed / 12 failed, same 12 pre-existing unrelated failures present on the base commit before this change.
